name: Eesti.ee
body: An llms.txt, a sitemap, share cards, HSTS, and DMARC that guards its mail. But the start page HTML holds no readable text and no h1, and made-up paths answer 200, because the app is drawn in JavaScript.
lesson: Pre-render pages to HTML and 404 unknown paths: AI crawlers read HTML, not apps.
summary: www.eesti.ee scores 83 out of 100 (B). 3 checks fail now, 11 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page.

fix.title: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page
fix.evidence: The HTML carries 0 characters of readable text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.
fix.fix: Render the main content on the server or pre-render it at build time.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 3.3 s (needs improvement), Interaction to Next Paint 111 ms (good), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.57 (poor). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds, ads, and late banners. Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 21/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 9.1 s, Total Blocking Time 491 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.765, Speed Index 10.4 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: A missing page answers 200 instead of 404
fix.evidence: A made-up path answered 200 with the title "Eesti.ee". Search engines call this a soft 404 and may index empty pages.
fix.fix: Return status 404 (or 410) for unknown paths, with a helpful page.

fix.title: 1 page has no canonical link
fix.evidence: /. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
